_comment: The declared proof must fail with an AssertionError after the exact temporary mutation collapses the all-deleted branch into the generic empty branch.

expectedRed.testName: the real @1611 Playwright journey rejects collapsed all-deleted copy
expectedRed.why: The proof temporarily changes the production all-deleted branch from `if (hasDeletedTenants) {` to `if (false) {`, rebuilds the Docker front runtime, and runs `e2e/tenant-portal-picker.spec.ts --grep @1611 --project chromium`. The journey must fail its visible 'Your organizations are no longer available' assertion; the restored source must pass the same journey.
